title: 第3章 五阶红阳果第4章 击杀黑云鹰
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
江尘很快就离开了小镇，往外面的大荒林而去。
大荒林是妖兽的生活区域，这儿生活着很多的妖兽，越是深入，妖兽的实力就越强大，里面还有很多灵药，很多修炼者都会冒险进入。
越是深入，获得珍贵的灵药的机会就越大，为敢深入的人很少。
绝多数人都是在外围活动，外围就算有灵药，基本被人采走了，在外围的妖兽实力也不强，但是偶尔也会有深处的强大妖兽会出现在外围区域，不过这个可能性比较低。
如果真是在外围遇到强大的妖兽，那么只能说自己的运气不好了。
“八荒掌。”
江尘一掌拍向一头黑毛猪的脑袋上，强大的力量直接将眼前的黑毛猪给击飞。
“吼……”
黑毛猪惨叫一声，倒在地上，抽搐几下就失去了气息。
眼前的黑毛猪是一阶六重的妖兽，居然被江尘一掌给拍死了。
江尘此时的气息是武徒境五重，真气十分凝实，他的实力远超同阶，就算杀一阶六重的妖兽也是轻易而举。
妖兽的实力本来就比同阶普通修炼者要强，这说明，在人族当中，江尘也可以碾压同阶修炼者，越级挑战，不在话下。
这是江尘进入大荒山脉第二天了。
江尘来到黑毛猪尸体面前，手中按在黑毛猪的身上，一股强大吸力出现在江尘的手中，疯狂地吞噬黑毛猪体内的血气之力，也就是灵力。
短短几息时间，黑毛猪体内的灵力被吞噬一空。
这些血气之力，如果江尘不吞噬的话，随着黑毛猪的死亡，也会慢慢散去的。
这是江尘杀死的第二十二头妖兽了，过于强大的妖兽，江尘不敢乱来，毕竟小命只有一条，现在的他还很弱小。
“我现在已经是武徒境五重后期了，再杀两三头妖兽，应能突破到武徒境六重。”
江尘大喜。
杀妖兽晋级真是太方便了，比吞噬资源要省事多了。

如果靠吞噬资源来晋级的话，不知道要多少成本呢。
这些妖兽的尸体，江尘没有动，因为此时的他没有储物袋，不方便带着这么多东西，但是遇到值钱的灵药的话，他还是会采摘的，灵药一般不大，带起来比较方便，江尘背着一个包裹。
江尘阅读过灵药书籍，一些常见的灵药他还是认识的。
“在这附近，妖兽的实力有点弱，我还是再深入一些，争取早日晋级到武者境。”
江尘心里想道。
江尘这一次进入大荒林，遇到最强的妖兽才是一阶七重，相当于人族武徒境七重的境界。
越是强大的妖兽，体内的血气之力就越庞大。
江尘于是快速往更加深入的区域而去。
前进了五十里后，突然，一道黑影挡住了江尘的去路。
“吼……”
棕暴熊朝着江尘怒吼一声。
“一阶十重的棕暴熊？”
江尘神色一凝。
棕暴熊的实力，在同阶妖兽之中也是很强大的存在，皮粗肉糙的，力量十分强大，缺点就是动作稍微慢点。
这是对于同阶的修炼者而言，对于境界低的修炼者，速度还是很快的。
“来得正好，那么就拿你来试手。”
江尘没有半点畏惧，打算跟棕暴熊战一场，试试现在自己战力的极限。
“崩拳。”
江尘的身影一动，出动全力，直接向棕暴熊给轰去。
棕暴熊对于江尘敢主动出击也是一愣，然后就是暴怒，同样向着江尘扑去。

一只巨大的熊爪同样拍向江尘。
江尘拳头与熊爪相撞。
沉闷声响起，棕暴熊瞬间被轰飞十几米。
content_en:
Jiang Chen quickly left the town and headed for the wild forest outside.
The Great Wilderness Forest is the living area of ​​monster beasts. There are many monster beasts living here. The deeper you go, the stronger the monster beasts become. There are also many spiritual medicines in it, and many cultivators will venture into it.
The deeper you go, the greater the chance of obtaining precious elixirs, but there are very few people who dare to go deep.
Most people are active in the periphery. Even if there are elixirs in the periphery, they are basically taken away by people. The monsters on the periphery are not strong, but occasionally powerful monsters from deep will appear in the peripheral area, but this possibility is relatively low.
If you really encounter a powerful monster in the periphery, you can only say that you are out of luck.
"Eight Desolate Palms."
Jiang Chen slapped a black-haired pig on the head, and the powerful force directly knocked the black-haired pig in front of him away.
"Roar..."
The black-haired pig screamed, fell to the ground, twitched a few times and then lost its breath.
The black-haired pig in front of him was a first-order and sixth-level monster, and it was actually killed by Jiang Chen's palm.
Jiang Chen's aura at this time was at the fifth level of the martial arts realm, and his true energy was very solid. His strength was far beyond that of the same level, and he could easily kill even a first-level and sixth-level monster.
The strength of monster beasts is inherently stronger than ordinary cultivators of the same level. This shows that among the human race, Jiang Chen can also crush cultivators of the same level and challenge them beyond the level.
This was Jiang Chen's second day after entering the Great Wilderness Mountain Range.
Jiang Chen came to the black-haired pig's body and pressed his hand on the black-haired pig's body. A strong suction force appeared in Jiang Chen's hand, frantically devouring the blood energy, that is, the spiritual power, in the black-haired pig's body.
In just a few breaths, the spiritual energy in the black-haired pig's body was swallowed up.
If Jiang Chen didn't swallow this power of blood, it would slowly dissipate with the death of the black-haired pig.
This was the twenty-second monster that Jiang Chen had killed. Jiang Chen did not dare to mess with the monster that was too powerful. After all, he only had one life, and he was still very weak now.
"I am now at the late stage of the fifth level of the martial arts realm. If I kill two or three more monsters, I should be able to break through to the sixth level of the martial arts realm."
Jiang Chen was overjoyed.
It's so convenient to kill monsters to advance, it's much easier than devouring resources.
If you rely on devouring resources to advance, I don’t know how much it will cost.
Jiang Chen did not move the corpses of these monster beasts because he did not have a storage bag at this time and it was inconvenient to carry so many things. However, if he encountered valuable elixirs, he would still pick them. The elixirs were generally not big and were more convenient to carry. Jiang Chen was carrying a package on his back.
Jiang Chen has read books on elixirs, and he is familiar with some common elixirs.
"Around here, the monsters are a bit weak. I'd better go deeper and try to advance to the warrior realm as soon as possible."
Jiang Chen thought to himself.
This time Jiang Chen entered the Great Wilderness Forest, and the strongest monster he encountered was the seventh level of the first level, which is equivalent to the seventh level of the human warrior realm.
The more powerful the monster, the greater the power of blood in its body.
Jiang Chen then quickly went deeper into the area.
After advancing for fifty miles, suddenly, a black shadow blocked Jiang Chen's path.
"Roar..."
The brown storm bear roared towards Jiang Chen.
"A first-level, tenth-level brown bear?"
Jiang Chen's expression condensed.
The brown storm bear is also very powerful among monsters of the same level. It has rough skin and rough flesh, and is very powerful. The disadvantage is that its movements are a little slow.
This is for cultivators of the same level, but for cultivators with lower realms, the speed is still very fast.
"It's just the right time, so I'll try it on you."
Jiang Chen was not afraid at all, and planned to fight the brown storm bear to test the limit of his current fighting power.
"Bang Fist."
Jiang Chen's figure moved, and he used all his strength to directly attack the brown bear.
The brown storm bear was also stunned that Jiang Chen dared to take the initiative, and then became furious and rushed towards Jiang Chen.
A huge bear claw also slapped Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen fistCollision with bear claws.
There was a dull sound, and the brown bear was instantly blown away more than ten meters.
